title: Validity of the certificate split
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $y$ be a Boolean word. If the split solver for $C,c,|y|$ returns $i$, then the suffix of $y$ after its first $i$ bits has length $C$ times one plus the length of the prefix of those first $i$ bits, raised to the power $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $i$ returned by the split solver for $C,c,|y|$
